bundle.longDescription: Version 2 (2026): the 2011 Vrikshayurveda program exactly as it was, with the scientific names updated to current accepted names (new name in brackets). Search 869 verses of five Sanskrit works by plant, common name, keyword or verse; hear the recitations; see each plant's classification, names, distribution, synonyms and pictures. Works offline.
